name: IE-Bench-4k
description: IE-Bench-4k is a 4k-example benchmark for evaluating information extraction capabilities of models, focusing on tasks such as entity/slot extraction and structured prediction from text. It provides a compact, diverse set of IE instances intended to test models' ability to identify and extract structured information rather than open-ended generation.
reputation: A niche but useful dataset for quick IE evaluations; not as widely adopted as large-scale IE benchmarks.
